hero.title: LINE MAN Wongnai x Navier - the water layer for two coasts and a river megacity
hero.subtitle: LINE MAN Wongnai already owns Thailand's daily-life demand - 10M+ users on LINE, 500K merchants, 250K riders. Water is the one transport surface no one owns yet.
hero.what_we_do_together: We launch a LINE MAN-branded foiling water tier across Thailand's strongest water flows - the Gulf islands, the Andaman, and the Chao Phraya - booked in the LINE MAN app, premium-priced, and category-defining. Navier brings the software-defined hydrofoiling fleet now proven in the Maldives; LINE MAN Wongnai brings the demand, the app built on LINE's ~50M Thai users, the rider network, and LINE Pay.

why_now: Thailand is the most water-rich market LINE MAN Wongnai serves - a million-plus Gulf island arrivals, the Andaman's iconic island flows, and ~40k daily Chao Phraya river trips - all on weather-fragile diesel boats with no premium in-app water tier. As Thailand's national-champion super-app pushes 'Digitalize Thailand' beyond food into ride-hailing (LINE MAN RIDE) and new premium tiers, the water is the obvious next surface to own.

why_navier_now.step_change: Hydrofoiling lifts the hull clear of the water, so a Navier vessel flies instead of plowing through chop - roughly 10x more efficient than a conventional planing boat, faster (30+ kt cruise), and dramatically smoother and quieter. It's software-defined and autonomy-ready, so the same fleet keeps getting better and cheaper to run over time. A step-change in marine mobility, not an incremental faster boat.
why_navier_now.no_new_infrastructure: Navier rides on infrastructure that already exists - the berths and jetties already in use across Thailand's islands and rivers. No vertiports, no new rights-of-way. Pioneer II needs only a berth pedestal; the Quanta-LR hybrid needs no charging infrastructure at all.
why_navier_now.the_moment: LINE MAN Wongnai owns the daily-life demand in every coastal and river cluster - the deepest, most hyper-local in-app network in Thailand. The water tier is the one mode no platform serves; Thailand's monsoon-fragile ferries and Bangkok's gridlock make the premium foiling layer an immediate, ownable wedge.

network_thesis.headline: One app. Two coasts and a river. The water layer of Thailand's national-champion super-app.
network_thesis.body: Thailand is the most water-rich market LINE MAN Wongnai serves - a Gulf coast of leisure islands, an Andaman coast of resort flows, and a river megacity - and as the home-grown national champion, LINE MAN Wongnai already owns the daily-life demand in all three. The same in-app foiling tier proven in the Maldives extends across each cluster. Start with the Samui triangle to prove it, then roll Phuket/Andaman and the Bangkok river.

markets.label: Koh Samui & the Gulf islands
markets.summary: The Samui-Phangan-Tao trio is one of Southeast Asia's densest leisure island chains - 1.13M air arrivals into Samui in just Jan-Apr 2025 feed a constant onward flow to Phangan's Full Moon scene and Koh Tao's dive schools, plus a wall of ultra-premium resorts (Four Seasons, Six Senses). Every onward leg today is a slow diesel catamaran that is weather-exposed and cancelled in monsoon swell. This is the flagship: the whole island triangle sits inside the all-electric envelope, the jetties already exist, and the premium tier is entirely unclaimed.

markets.label: Bangkok - river tier & gulf gateway
markets.summary: Bangkok runs on the Chao Phraya - ~40,000 river-commuter trips a day on a mature but basic diesel express-boat network, under a city choked by road gridlock.
